rationale: Dedicated recurring audited-statements archive of a systemic Kosovo bank; clean structured extraction target.
ESG sub-page on the NLB Kosovo domain already covered by the parent disclosure monitoring; URL unverified.
High-frequency auction/collateral notice feed is a genuine NPL-stress signal, but liveness must be re-checked.
BKT Kosova own-domain IFRS/annual report repository; recurring disclosure, failed URL is a soft signal only.
Long public annual-report archive (2003-2023) of a domestic bank; strong time-series value.
Publishes both IFRS and CBK-template statements, enabling reconciliation of regulator aggregates to bank data.
Quarterly (TM1-TM4) statement cadence back to ~2015 — most granular own-channel source in the cell.
Top-tier bank's own financial-statements page; must be crawled since documents are unindexed.
Licensed bank corporate site but no disclosure surface confirmed; recheck before committing to monitoring.
Newest licensed bank's site; disclosure presence unconfirmed, worth a second look rather than approval.
Regulator reporting-template framework defines the schema for parsing bank statements; also the sr-language entry point.
Banking association member list is a one-off actor map; own domain unconfirmed, hosted on a member bank page.
Business registry is the de facto substitute for exchange disclosure of ownership/capital changes at unlisted banks.
Parent-group IR gives segment and strategy detail for foreign-owned Kosovo subsidiaries ahead of local disclosure.
Valuable standardised bank financials but paywalled; requires a licence/subscription decision by a human.
Mine once as a bank-to-domain seed roster; CBK register remains the authoritative actor list.
Authoritative central-bank portal covering banking regulation, payment systems and stability reports, with sr mirror.
NBS statement archive is the primary counterparty disclosure on the dinar/payments regime affecting Kosovo.
Recurring local outlet with unmatched granularity on branch closures, ATM/card access and CBK enforcement.
Mitrovica broadcaster publishing bank service notices and payment-access reporting; steady signal producer.
Second enclave geography for banking access and cash-vs-card behaviour; partly overlaps Kontakt Plus.
Standing economy vertical carrying CBK and bank announcements quickly; credibility moderate, use as tip feed.
Economy section of a national daily; useful sustained payments coverage, monitor as a section feed.
Independent regional broadcaster with document-cited coverage of both Pristina and Belgrade payment measures.
First-party site of the state bank running the parallel budget-payout channel; direct payments-actor disclosure.
Bank customer-notice channel documenting exit from the Kosovo branch network and card/e-banking migration.
Government press portal relevant to parallel-finance measures but politically framed and URL unverified.
Single article quantifying the crossing-point pension payout workaround; keep as evidence, not a monitored feed.
